infoYearT1.evidence_source: [016_4_study_1_national_child_development_study] The National Child Development Study (NCDS) is a longitudinal study of all people born in Great Britain in one week of March 1958. The NCDS has followed these individuals through childhood and into adulthood, with data collected at ages 7, 11, 16, 23, 33, 42, 46, 50, and 55.
